run_gen_data_main: run gen_data.py to generate StarCraft II unit, buff, and upgrade definitions from the game
summarize_get_data: summarize the get_data function that connects to a StarCraft II game and retrieves static data
summarize_generate_py_units: summarize generate_py_units which outputs Python IntEnum classes for units grouped by race
summarize_generate_py_buffs: summarize generate_py_buffs which outputs a Python IntEnum class for game buffs
summarize_generate_py_upgrades: summarize generate_py_upgrades which outputs a Python IntEnum class for game upgrades
